sections.title: Acceptance
sections.body: Welcome to Verde Player (the “App”). By downloading, installing, or using the App, you agree to these Terms of Use (the “Terms”). If you do not agree, please do not use the App.

sections.title: Offline-First Music Player
sections.body:
The App is designed as an offline-first music player. Core features — including playback, library management, liked songs, playback history, and search — operate entirely on your device without requiring an internet connection.

You are solely responsible for the music files you import, store, and play within the App. We do not host, stream, or provide any music content.

sections.title: Internet and External Services
sections.body:
You can use the App completely offline for normal operation. Internet access is never required for core playback or library features.

The App or your device may connect to external services only in limited circumstances, such as:

  • Downloading updates through the Apple App Store.
  • Fetching publicly hosted legal documents (such as these Terms) from GitHub Pages.
  • Communications you initiate by emailing us or posting on our GitHub Issues page.

The App does not automatically upload your music library, playback history, or other personal data to our servers.

sections.body: All audio files and metadata you add to the App remain your exclusive property. We do not claim ownership over your content. You are responsible for ensuring that you have the legal right to store and play those files using the App.
